title: The Bundle on the Doorstep
synopsis: A basket. A baby. A note: 'I trust you.' You don't know who 'I' is.

nodes.text: She is sleeping. A tiny hat. No tags. You cannot avoid Crib; you can only decide whether “Bring her in” or “Call police” defines the person who reaches it.

choices.consequence: You commit to bring her in. By Crib, the choice has already shifted who trusts you and who begins to watch.
You commit to call police. By Crib, the choice has already shifted who trusts you and who begins to watch.

nodes.text: You don't own a crib. The laundry basket has just been emptied. The Note is already waiting. What changes is whether “Improvise” or “Drive to the 24-hour store” is the instinct you carry into it.

choices.consequence: You commit to improvise. By The Note, the choice has already shifted who trusts you and who begins to watch.
You choose to drive to the 24-hour store. It opens the route to The Note, giving up the protection of pretending you had not decided.

nodes.text: Handwritten. 'I trust you. I'll come back. Hours comes either way; its meaning changes with the difference between “Believe it” and “Doubt it.”

choices.consequence: You choose to believe it. It opens the route to Hours, giving up the protection of pretending you had not decided.
You commit to doubt it. By Hours, the choice has already shifted who trusts you and who begins to watch.

nodes.text: She fusses, then sleeps, then fusses. You learn fast. You cannot avoid Knock; you can only decide whether “Stay calm” or “Cry quietly” defines the person who reaches it.

choices.consequence: You choose to stay calm. It opens the route to Knock, giving up the protection of pretending you had not decided.
You commit to cry quietly. By Knock, the choice has already shifted who trusts you and who begins to watch.

nodes.text: A woman, exhausted, at the door at sunrise. She is, you understand instantly, the mother. Coffee will follow either decision, but it will meet a different version of you after “Welcome her in” than after “Stand at the door.”

choices.consequence: You welcome her in. The decision moves you toward Coffee and tells everyone present what you are willing to risk.
You choose to stand at the door. It opens the route to Coffee, giving up the protection of pretending you had not decided.

nodes.text: She drinks two cups. She tells you, slowly, the year she has had. The distance between Aunt, Unofficially and Quietly Yours begins with the choice between “Listen” and “Offer help.”

choices.consequence: You commit to listen. By Aunt, Unofficially, the choice has already shifted who trusts you and who begins to watch.
You offer help. The decision moves you toward Quietly Yours and tells everyone present what you are willing to risk.

nodes.text: You become an aunt-figure to the baby. You help out for a year. The mother gets back on her feet.
You don't tell most people. The week is yours. The baby grows up. You keep a small photo in a drawer.
